name: IBM Simon

images.credit: Bcos47, Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Dimensions: 8 in H, 2.5 in W, 1.5 in D

Platform.CPU: NEC V30HL, 16 MHz, 16-bit, 8086-compatible CPU as part of Vadem VG230 System on a chip

Memory.RAM: 1 MB PSRAM (2× Hitachi HM658512LTT) , 32 KB SRAM (Sony CXK58257)
Memory.Storage: 1 MB NOR Flash (Intel/Hitachi) expanded to 2 MB by Stacker compression + 32KB BIOS NOR Flash

Display.Display: 4.5 x, 160 × 293 pixel CGA monochrome backlit LCD

Connectivity.Connectivity: 2400-bit/s Hayes command set, Hayes-compatible modem, 33-pin connector, 9600-bps Group 3 send-and-receive fax, I/O connection port, PC Card, PCMCIA type 2
